correctness.rationale: For the simple graph Ci_16(1,8), the 24 sorted edges are vertices of the *ordinary* matching complex (all vertex-disjoint partial matchings, not only perfect-extendible). An independently constructed bitmask enumerator counted 11394 augmented matchings (11393 nonempty), the complete eight-entry f-vector, and 5690 nonempty toggle pairs in the exact 24-edge order; all 55256 ordinary Hasse covers passed full topological acyclicity. It recovered one 0-cell, five 4-cells, seven 5-cells and the exact printed 5x7 signed integer boundary. Its integer Smith factors [1,1,1], with rank exactly 3 and no nonunit factors, yield two 4-spheres and four 5-spheres by Hurewicz and unimodular cellular cancellation. Ordinary matching vs perfect-matching subcomplex normalization and exclusion of arbitrary 16-vertex graphs are explicit.
